data.long_meaning: The name Laljeet is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Lal’ which means ‘red’ and ‘Jee’ which means ‘God’. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as having a red hue. Laljeet is a powerful and auspicious name that signifies the divine presence of the God within. The name Laljeet carries the meaning “Red-colored God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Laljeet usually hope their child will grow to embody red-colored god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
